enableServiceLinks.description: Set false to stop Kubernetes injecting {SVCNAME}_SERVICE_HOST/_PORT env vars for in-namespace Services into Pods. Unset defaults to the Kubernetes default (true).

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Pod-level automountServiceAccountToken. Set false for workloads that never call the Kubernetes API. Unset defaults to the Kubernetes default (the ServiceAccount's setting, normally true). IRSA is unaffected.
